notes: Total 60 as published. 'Spies (8)', 'EPP (8)' and 'Alien (2)' are sub-headers under 'Characters (18)', not cards.

No starting section; the strategy says 'Start MPG + NR' with starting Effects varying by matchup ('As a default, start ANSB'), so Hoth: Main Power Generators is set as the starting card and no starting Effect or Interrupt is set.
Posted 'Battle Order' (a Dark card) on this Light list dested the Light Effect Battle Plan; the strategy's matchup starts name 'Battle Plan' ('Start Wise Advice, Aim High, Battle Plan').

Posted 'Yoda Stew (Also known as Traffic Control)' dested Yoda Stew (the parenthetical is a joke; the addendum suggests Yoda Stew & You Do Have Your Moments as a replacement, not applied). Wise Advice is the Special Edition Effect (not the Reflections III shield).

Posted 'Ounee Tay' dested Ounee Ta; 'Twaas Khaa' Tawss Khaa; 'Lt. Blout' Lieutenant Blount; 'Jeron Webb' Jeroen Webb; 'Momaw Naden' Momaw Nadon; 'Lando With Axe' Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Tantative IV' Tantive IV; 'Luke w/', 'Obi w/', 'Leia w/', 'Han w/' (under 'EPP') Luke With Lightsaber, Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol.
